what.text: This page follows refugees from Armenia in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 15578 refugees from Armenia.
France hosts the largest share, 42.7%, followed by Germany, the United States and Belgium.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Armenia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 to 1999.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1964 at 170 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 203690, at the end of 1997, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
